headline: Arisinfra Solutions Limited files SEBI Takeover Regulation Disclosure
sum: Arisinfra Solutions Limited has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares crossing one or more regulatory thresholds; specific acquirer identity and shareholding shift remain restricted to the filed document.
implication: The filing triggers mandatory continuous disclosure obligations and opens a 4-week public announcement window under the Takeover Code; practitioners must verify threshold breached, timing of prior acquisitions, and whether an open offer is triggered under Regulation 26.
detail: Arisinfra Solutions Limited has submitted formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, as evidenced by the NSE archive filing dated 23 June 2026 (TEAM_SANDESHC_23062026125050_ARIS.zip). Regulation 31(4) requires disclosure when a person acquires shares crossing specified thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, etc.). The specific details-acquirer identity, share quantity, consideration, prior shareholding-are contained in the filed disclosure document and not released in summary form to public search databases.
